mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting delayed monetary easing and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as volatility rises.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal a tightening labor market, driving corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 750.0 (thousand units) in a late-cycle expansion regime indicates overheated housing demand, triggering profit-taking and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 750.0.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 95.0 signals weakening industrial activity, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 below 13500.0 (billions) signals imminent recession, triggering risk-off flows and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 13500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous RSAFS growth and HOUST increases signal robust aggregate demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases and HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 230.0 in a high-inflation regime pressures real rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as central banks tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.0.
